Why is this important?

It will automate the end-to-end test execution and will avoid to be dependent on manual trigger. As MTR will have sunset near September. We expect to have few z-stream releases meanwhile.

A. Include within this test matrix:

*Stage:*
 * MTR Operator (Deploy)
 * Bundle validation for STAGE
 * Regression all Tier run
 * Windup CLI

 - mtr-windup-standalone Full run
 - mtr-windup-tests-via-operator secure and non-secure full run

*GA:*
 * MTR Operator (Deploy)
 * bungle validation for GA
 * Regression Tier 1

 - Windup Cli
